<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **16** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/automation.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/automation.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/translation.md`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**28** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 07b17542a24a6d1cc89342a949901f47e93c76aa`.

⛔ **15** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/automation.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/automation.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/translation.md`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **68** of **251** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **185** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 07b17542a24a6d1cc89342a949901f47e93c76aa` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `e95517f99a24043c8c78eef304a4c996482b9a9d` — the merge of head `04d28e04f9310fed7f4c981e5f12771d8df2f861` into base `07b17542a24a6d1cc89342a949901f47e93c76aa`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin e95517f99a24043c8c78eef304a4c996482b9a9d && git checkout e95517f99a24043c8c78eef304a4c996482b9a9d
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 07b17542a24a6d1cc89342a949901f47e93c76aa 04d28e04f9310fed7f4c981e5f12771d8df2f861 && git checkout -B drift-repro 07b17542a24a6d1cc89342a949901f47e93c76aa && git merge --no-ff 04d28e04f9310fed7f4c981e5f12771d8df2f861

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 07b17542a24a6d1cc89342a949901f47e93c76aa
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 07b17542a24a6d1cc89342a949901f47e93c76aa` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

L1 REWORK · head `bc0171d889865edd7c67d80ec52c392ac6d68590` · 2026-11-22T17:49Z

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:应用包现在可以给流程里每个步骤(开始、判断、通知、结束等)写各语言的名称。手册里的流程图和 Studio 流程画布都按读者的语言显示这些步骤名,中文手册里不再夹着英文。已经发布了翻译语言的应用,缺译检查里会多出这些步骤的提示。
- 为什么做:卡 #35979 第 2 项,你在卡上选了「补上翻译位,可以翻译」(7076440876)。第 1 项是已合并的 #36335。
- 出错会怎样:只影响显示和缺译提示,不改流程运行,也不改任何数据。可以整体撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。
- 席位意见:REWORK,2 项,都只改声明行,不动代码。键、校验、缺译要求和两处读取我读下来都是对的,见下面。

## 要改的(2 项)

1. **`Skills-docs:` 这一行要改成卡号的写法。** 正文和 changeset 现在都写着 `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md (#36401)`。按清单,`follow-up owed` 在卡立好之后,要把这一行改写成 `#N`。#36401 已经立了,所以两处都改成 `Skills-docs: follow-up #36401`。l1-face 的 skills-docs 旗就是这一项。

2. **`Clause-②` 的放宽清单漏了 `@object-ui/i18n` 的一处公开类型改动。** `FlowLabelTranslations` 是 `@object-ui/i18n` 包根导出的类型(`index.ts` 里 `export … type FlowLabelTranslations`)。本 PR 给它加了一个必填成员 `screenTitle`,并把 `stepLabel` 的参数放宽成可带 `config`。changeset 的正文已经写了「`FlowLabelTranslations` gains `screenTitle`」,但正文和 changeset 的 `Clause-②: yes (widening: …)` 尾部只列了翻译键和 `@objectstack/spec/automation` 的两个导出。请在两处的尾部补上这一项,和 #36351 那一轮的做法一样,把每一处放宽都列出来。仓库里构造这个类型的只有 `flowLabelTranslations` 自己(app-shell 的上下文只是转手传递),所以不需要改成可选。

## 席位核对

- **卡片关系**:首行 `Part of #35979`,写明只做第 2 项,第 1 项是已合并的 #36335。裁定 7076440876 的三条:
  1. 每个画出来的步骤都有可翻译的标签键,spec、校验和业务视图的读取都做了;
  2. 已有的 `i18n/missing-flow` 扩展为要这个键,没有新建门禁,HotCRM 的 9 条另立 #36402;
  3. 开始和结束节点不由查看器自己出词,和别的步骤一样要翻译。正文给了实测理由:showcase 里的开始和结束标签很多是结果或触发条件,例如 Approved、On Task Created。

  三条都交付了。`Part of` 对,卡保留 `pm:dispatched`。#36400(流程名的缺译要求)和 #36402 另立卡,正文写了。
- **spec**:`flows.<flow>.nodes.<node_id>.label` 是 strict 的条目,只有一个纯文本的 `label` 叶子。它覆盖除 `screen`、`approval` 以外的节点,任何深度都算,所以一个字符串只有一个键。原来 `nodes`、`steps` 是指向 `screens` 的未知键提示,现在 `nodes` 是真正的组,`node`、`steps`、`step` 指向它。别名只是被拒时给的改名建议,不是接受集,所以改指向不算收窄。docblock 和约定列表都补了。
- **校验**:写在 `screen` 上的 `nodes` 键指向 `screens.<id>.title`,写在 `approval` 上的指向 `approvals.<id>.label`。节点不存在时报 `translation-target-unknown`,并给出最接近的节点。反过来,`screens` / `approvals` 键写在别的节点上时,两条旧消息的结尾从「so nothing resolves」改成「its label is keyed `nodes.<id>.label`」。
- **缺译要求**:`walkScreenFlows` 只要顶层、不是技术类型、不是 screen 或 approval、有 id 的节点。嵌套在区域里的节点校验接受但不要求,理由是文档嵌入不画它们。这和 `FlowView` 只画顶层节点一致。
- **一张表**:`FLOW_TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES` 和原来查看器私有的 `TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES` 逐项相同(9 个类型),查看器和缺译检查都读它。
- **读取**:`stepLabel` 按类型读:approval 读 `approvals`,没有 `config.title` 的 screen 读 `screens.title`,其余读 `nodes`。`flowStepName` 对写了 `config.title` 的 screen 用它的标题(有译文用译文),标题里有 `{{` 时退回作者写的标签,和正文、changeset 说的一致。判断分支的目标也走 `flowStepName`。Studio 画布(含区域里的嵌套节点)读同一个 `stepLabel`。
- **声明**:`Clause-②: yes (widening)` 方向对,清单见第 2 项。`Metadata-protocol: added` 对,加了一个翻译键。不是 `!`,也没有 `(narrowing)`,不欠 dogfood。
- **changeset**:五个包都有条目;spec、lint、cli、i18n 是 minor,components 是 patch。正文各段我逐句核过,和 diff 一致:键、开始结束、缺译要求、两处读取、带标题的 screen、一张表。
- **已发布文档**:`i18n-standard.mdx` 的键表加了 `flows.{flow}.nodes.{node}` 一行,`translations.mdx` 加了「流程步骤名」一行,生成的 `translation.mdx` 已重新生成。每一句都和代码一致。
- **示例与基线**:`app-crm` 补了三条中文,基线仍是 0。`app-showcase` 317 → 424、`app-todo` 106 → 128 是新的待译条目,按首次纳入一类新键的先例上调。正文写了 `check:i18n-coverage` 前后的读数。
- **测试**:cli 新增一个家族文件 `i18n-flow-node-coverage`(6 条,其中 HotCRM `opportunity_approval` 的形状只要开始、判断、通知、循环、结束);三处同族文件改用谓词,把 `nodes` 家族排除在精确清单之外;lint 新增一组 describe;components 和 FlowCanvas 各加了用例。
- **门禁读数**:spec 那一半在 `cafc3fdf`,127 条里 126 条 exit 0,1 条没测到,是 `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`,交给 CI。读取那一半在本 head `bc0171d8`(合入 main 之后):96 条全部 exit 0,`--ran` 对得上。
- **CI @ `bc0171d8`**:63 success、11 skipped、0 failed;mergeable clean。
- **落地**:改了 `translation.zod.ts`,席位在并行跑契约档 L2。两份评审都通过后,由区 ready + auto-merge。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `bc0171d889865edd7c67d80ec52c392ac6d68590`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/automation/flow-altitude.ts, packages/spec/src/automation/index.ts, packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts + packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/flowLabels.ts, ui/packages/components/src/renderers/basic/metadata-viewer.tsx, packages/spec/liveness/translation.json

Read: card #35979 body and all 10 comments (ruling 7076440876, the item 1 report and closing note, dev report 7083079826), the PR body, its 27-file list, the net diff against merge-base dda5e74f, and the 74 check-runs on this head (63 success, 11 skipped, none failed or pending). The whole PR is judged, not the delta since 47a645c5. The PR is still a draft. Follow-up cards #36400, #36401 and #36402 exist and are open.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set, `flows.FLOW.nodes.NODE_ID.label` (translation.zod.ts): right.** One new optional group on the flow entry. Each entry is strict and holds one optional plain-string leaf, `label`. `nodes` was refused before, so the move is refused to accepted: a pure widening. No existing key changes shape or becomes required, so a bundle that parsed on `main` parses unchanged.
- **Aliases: right.** `aliases` on `strictObject` only pick the hint an unknown key is refused with (strict-object.ts). They accept nothing and rename nothing. So `steps` moving from a `screens` hint to a `nodes` hint, and the new `node` and `step` hints, change a refusal sentence and no accepted shape. `nodes` leaving the alias table is required, since it is now a real key. The entry's own aliases (`title`, `name`, `heading`, `stepLabel`, `text` onto `label`) are hints of the same kind. Strictness ledger 407 to 408 matches the one new strict site.
- **Validator (validate-translation-references.ts): right.** A `nodes` key is accepted over any node id the flow declares, at any depth, whose type is neither `screen` nor `approval`. Over a screen it redirects to `screens.NODE_ID.title`, over an approval to `approvals.NODE_ID.label`. An unknown id is an orphan, and the suggestions leave out screens and approvals. The universe is the same `walkFlowNodes` plus artifact-provided flows the sibling groups use. The two reworded redirects (`screens` or `approvals` over another node type now name `nodes.NODE_ID.label`) are true at this head. Every new refusal sits inside the new key, so nothing an author could write before is refused now.
- **Reader (flowLabels.ts, metadata-viewer.tsx): right, and it matches the validator one for one.** `stepLabel` reads `approvals.NODE_ID.label` for an approval, `screens.NODE_ID.title` for a screen whose `config.title` is absent or empty, `nodes.NODE_ID.label` for any other type, and never one type's group under another type's id. `ScreenConfigSchema.title` is a string, and the engine falls back to the node label when the title renders nothing, so the untitled test agrees with the executor. `flowStepName` names a titled screen by its translated heading, else its authored heading, unless the heading holds a `{{` hole, and then by the authored label. The step list and the branch-target list both go through it. `activeFlowsBundle` forwards the whole `flows` group, so `nodes` and `screens` reach the reader with no second loader.
- **Nested nodes: right.** Validation accepts a `nodes` key at any depth, and it now has a reader: the Studio canvas (`FlowCanvas`) and `RegionNode` in flow-region-view.tsx both call the shared `stepLabel` on the node itself, which carries `type` and `config`. The earlier record's concern that a nested key translated nothing is closed.
- **Folding table: right.** `FLOW_TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES` holds the same nine types, in the same order, as the private set the viewer drops in this diff. The viewer filters by `isFlowTechnicalNodeType` and the walk skips by it. `api-surface/automation.json` and `export-origins/automation.json` gain exactly these two rows. Nothing is removed or renamed.
- **Walk demand (i18n-walk.ts, `i18n/missing-flow`): right for the step list, short for the branch list (see S1).** It asks for top-level nodes that are not a screen, an approval, a technical type or id-less, seeded from `node.label`. That is the step list `FlowView` draws at business altitude.
- **Ledger: right.** `flows.nodes` and its `label` child are `live`, and each cited reader exists at this head and reads the key. State counts 47 to 48 live, 49 to 50 classified. No `authorWarn`, which a `live` row refuses.
- **Baseline: right.** showcase 317 to 424 and todo 106 to 128 are the new population, and app-crm stays 0 with its three new zh-CN entries. The i18n coverage and walk-parity gates are green on this head.
- **`FlowLabelTranslations.screenTitle` (`@object-ui/i18n`): right.** A new member on an exported interface. The one producer is `flowLabelTranslations`, and no other code builds the object. `stepLabel` now also reads `config`, a wider input. Additive for every reader.

### ② Semver level

- `Metadata-protocol: added` is right: one new key an author can write, nothing narrowed, no meaning changed.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is right against the public surface: the new accepted key and two new exports from `@objectstack/spec/automation`. No narrowing arm is owed. The line is line-initial in the PR body and the changeset, and they agree.
- The changeset names `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/cli` and `@object-ui/i18n` at minor and `@object-ui/components` at patch. All five are in the one `fixed` group, so they publish at minor together, which is what `added` owes on a moved package. `examples/app-crm` is private. The changeset gates are green.
- The changeset prose matches the tree, with one overstatement, graded as S1: "they agree on which steps a reader sees".

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev report 7083079826: `open_questions` is empty.** Nothing to answer there.
- **Deviation, titled screen with a holed heading: accepted.** In the docs embed such a screen keeps its authored label, which has no key. The PR and the changeset both say so. Closing it later means accepting `nodes` over a titled screen, which is a widening and can land at any time. The Studio canvas keeps the authored label of every titled screen, which is the string the designer edits. No card tracks this residue yet; the seat should file one, because the card's done-when (no English step left) is not met for such a screen.
- **Deviation, attribution link and no review request: process only.** No effect on the tree.
- **Ruling item 3 (start and end nodes): decided and stated.** They are keyed like any other step, and the viewer supplies no words of its own. The reader agrees.
- **Out-of-scope findings: filed.** #36400 (the `flows.FLOW.label` demand), #36401 (the i18n skill text, matching the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line) and #36402 (HotCRM's nine step names) are open.
- **Earlier record on 47a645c5:** E1 (served tier) is met by this record. E2 (reader half) is met: the viewer reads the spec table and the key, and the ledger row is `live`. Its three carried findings are closed by the tree except the titled-screen residue above. The `steps` alias now hints at `nodes`.
- **Read, not reviewed (outside the diff):** the header of `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/flow-label-translations.tsx` and one comment in `flow-region-view.tsx` still say the designer reads the approval label only. They are stale beside this PR.
- **SQL push-down:** not applicable. The diff touches no query path, no id materialisation and no in-app join.

### ④ Design judgment

- **translation.zod.ts against ruling 7076440876 and its first consumer: holds.** The ruling asks for a translatable label key per flow node under the flow's bundle. The key is addressed by `FlowNode.id` like every sibling group, overlays `FlowNode.label`, and is plain text, which is right because the label is never rendered over a run's variables. Keeping screens and approvals on their own keys keeps one key per string and makes the validator's redirects exact. I tried an old bundle (parses), a `nodes` key over a screen, an approval, a nested node and an unknown id (redirected, redirected, accepted, refused), and a `steps` or `step` key (refused, pointed at `nodes`). None breaks the design.
- **flow-altitude.ts and index.ts against their two readers: hold for the fold.** The viewer and the walk read the one table, so the step list and the demand cannot drift. The guard takes `unknown` and is safe on a missing type.

S1 (should-fix): the walk does not ask for every step name the embed draws at business altitude. `Branches` in metadata-viewer.tsx resolves each decision branch target against all top-level nodes, technical ones included, and names it through `flowStepName`, which reads `nodes.NODE_ID.label`. The walk skips every technical type. So a decision that leads to a technical step shows that step's name in the authored language, the key exists, and `i18n/missing-flow` stays silent. It is live in the repo: `examples/app-todo/src/flows/task.flow.ts`, edge `e3`, leads `check_recurring` (a decision) to `compute_next_due_date` (a `script`). This contradicts the flow-altitude.ts jsdoc ("exactly the steps that viewer draws at its default altitude") and the changeset ("they agree on which steps a reader sees"), and it leaves ruling item 2 short for those names. Fix one side: the walk also asks for the top-level targets of a top-level decision's out-edges, with the baseline raised to match, or the branch list stops naming a folded step by its label, or the jsdoc and changeset state the gap and a card carries it.

N1 (nit): the `nodes` docblock in translation.zod.ts says the group covers "every node whose label has no key of its own" and that a screen is "keyed already, so one string keeps one key". A titled screen's canvas label has no key at all: `screens.NODE_ID.title` translates its heading, not its label. The changeset says this correctly. The docblock should say it too when the file is next touched.

N2 (nit): an untitled screen's translated `screens.NODE_ID.title` is drawn by `stepLabel` without the `{{` test that `flowStepName` applies to a titled screen's heading. A translation that adds a hole would be drawn raw. Narrow, and display only.

## 维护者速读
